specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Defenders or Mountain Guards by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every level (rounded up).
Increases Speed of any Snow Falcons or Blizzard Falcons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of any Javeliners or Harpooners by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of any Brutes or Berserks by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Speed of any Gladiators or Flame Gladiators by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
Increases the Armored Cannon's Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
Casts Ice Bolt with Damage increased by 10% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
Casts Fireball with Damage increased by 10% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
Casts FireShield with Damage increased by 10% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
Increases the Speed of any Snow Witches or Ice Sorceresses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
